class.name: NetwJoinConfig
class.brief_description: Settings for the join handler, returned by [method Netw.configure_join].
class.description:
[method quantize] compresses the arguments a client passes to [method Netw.prepare_join] after its username. The first quantizer is for the second parameter of the handler, after its [NetwPlayer]. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_join(spawn_at) \ .quantize(null, NetwQuantizeScalar.new().bits(4).limits(0, 8))
func spawn_at(who: NetwPlayer, point: StringName, team: int) -> void: ... [/codeblock]

method.name: quantize
method.description: Compresses each join argument with one [NetwQuantize], in order. [code]null[/code] sends an argument as is. The number of quantizers must match the number of arguments. Returns this config.
